model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy (%ACC) of several methods as a function of co-occurrence number. The x-axis is labeled ‘Co-occurrence Number’ and employs a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1.0 to 1000 with tick intervals of 10 and 100, representing values of 1, 10, 100, 1000. The y-axis is labeled ‘ACC (%)’ and displays a linear scale, ranging from 35 to 65 with tick intervals of 5, indicating accuracy percentages. The ‘Base’ line is represented by black circles and a solid line, beginning at approximately 38% at a co-occurrence number of 1.0 and ending at approximately 40% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The ‘MEND’ line is represented by purple diamonds and a solid line, beginning at approximately 42% at a co-occurrence number of 1.0 and ending at approximately 48% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The ‘FT’ line is represented by cyan triangles and a solid line, beginning at approximately 46% at a co-occurrence number of 1.0 and ending at approximately 55% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The ‘MEMIT’ line is represented by magenta hexagons and a solid line, beginning at approximately 44% at a co-occurrence number of 1.0 and ending at approximately 52% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The ‘IKE’ line is represented by red squares and a solid line, beginning at approximately 40% at a co-occurrence number of 1.0 and ending at approximately 45% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The ‘ROME’ line is represented by green hexagons and a solid line, beginning at approximately 38% at a co-occurrence number of 1.0 and ending at approximately 42% at a co-occurrence number of 1000.
